title: Detection by local primitives on finite split refinements
statement: Let X be qcqs, A a Grothendieck abelian category, S an exact short complex of A-valued small-etale sheaves, U a finite split etale hypercover, n≥0, and x:B→S.X₂(U_n) a cycle [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]. If a morphism g:B→T is zero after precomposition with every π:B′→B for which, on some finite split refinement f:V→U, the restricted πx has a primitive l:B′→S.X₁(V_n), then g=0.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1, local lifting for the hypercover computation; Stacks Tags 00WL and 01H0

proof.text: The finite splitting and finite qcqs nondegenerate cofans show U_n is qcqs. Evaluation preserves the kernel of S.g, so x is a map into (ker S.g)(U_n), and exactness makes p:S.X₁→ker S.g epic.

Apply the categorical local epimorphism detector to p. For any source map π with lifts on a covering sieve R, apply finite refinement to the single degree-n requirement R. Its finite colimiting cofan in V_n has each composite in R.

Identify this cofan with a scheme coproduct. Its inclusions form an etale cover. The sheaf axiom glues morphisms from B′ on the disjoint pieces uniquely; intersections of different summands have empty source and same-summand equalities follow from monicity. Glue the primitives. Naturality of p and uniqueness of gluing identify their image with restricted πx, first in the kernel sheaf and then in S.X₂. The hypothesis kills πg; the detector concludes g=0, including empty cofans and zero coefficients.

proof_origin.place: Agent-written categorical coefficient generalization of the local image and local primitive arguments in Stacks Tags 00WL and 01H0. Those sources themselves concern set-valued and abelian sheaves, respectively. Finite matching diagrams and AB5 provide the general-coefficient argument recorded here.

lean.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_refinement_primitives
    (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A)) (hS : S.Exact)
    (U : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X) (n : ℕ) (B T : A)
    (x : B ⟶ S.X₂.obj.obj (op (U.simplicial.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))))
    (hx : x ≫ S.g.hom.app _ = 0) (g : B ⟶ T)
    (hkill : ∀ (V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X) (f : V.Refinement U) (B' : A)
      (π : B' ⟶ B)
      (l : B' ⟶ S.X₁.obj.obj (op (V.simplicial.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))),
      l ≫ S.f.hom.app _ = π ≫ x ≫ S.X₂.obj.map
        (f.app (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op → π ≫ g = 0) :
    g = 0
